name: Worn Boots
description: A pair of well-worn leather boots. Comfortable for long marches.

name: Iron-Shod Boots
description: Reinforced leather boots with iron toe-caps. Sturdy and intimidating.

name: Leather Boots
description: Rugged brown leather boots, perfect for exploring dark damp corridors.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Sabatons
description: Ornate silver boots that allow for silent, effortless movement. The embedded amethysts glow when the wearer is in motion.

name: Celestial Vindicator Sabatons
description: Solid silver boots inlaid with glowing white runes. Each step leaves a faint trail of radiant yellow dust.

name: Ironpeak Dwarf Sabatons
description: Thick iron sabatons, grounding a dwarf so strongly that they are almost impossible to knock over.

name: Sylvan Elderwood Boots
description: Silent boots that tread softly upon any surface, leaving no trace behind.

name: Mountain Stalker Boots
description: Heavy-duty boots with iron crampons for climbing the steepest peaks.

name: Aethelgard Archmage Slippers
description: Enchanted slippers that never touch the ground, allowing for a near-silent stride.

name: Storm-Reaver Sabatons
description: Spiked iron boots that leave a trail of destruction with every step.

name: Seraphic Grace Sandals
description: Lightweight sandals that make the wearer feel as if they are walking on clouds.
